An engineering test-plan generator reads requirements, identifies verification methods (test, analysis, inspection, demonstration), and drafts procedures with pass criteria, sample sizes, and traceability. Real implementations are template-driven tools inside ALM suites (Jama, Polarion) plus AI-assisted drafters. It sizes samples from reliability targets and links every case back to its requirement.

title: Engineering Test-Plan Generator — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Drafts complete verification test plans from requirements and risk analysis.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Engineering Test-Plan Generator, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Requirement parsing into verifiable shall-statements). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Requirement parsing into verifiable shall-statements and Verification-method assignment per requirement. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Automated test execution framework) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
capabilities: Procedure drafting with setup, steps, and pass criteria
